name: zrndr_flush_transparent_queue
description: zRndr::FlushTransparentQueue sorts queued transparent polygons by depth, restores per-command depth and scan-convert state, draws each command, and clears the queue count.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zRndr queued-polygon rendering pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x49a2b0 validates reverse index initialization, depth-based bubble sort, per-command state restore, draw dispatch, and final queue-count reset.
The native smoke verifies depth sort order, queue drain, and restoration of inverse-depth bias, inverse-depth scale, and scan-convert mode from the last drained command.
